requirements.statement: Athletes sign in securely so their workout data stays private

criteria.must: An unauthenticated user is redirected to sign in before reaching any workout data
After a successful sign-in, the Athlete lands on their own dashboard
An authenticated Athlete cannot view another Athlete's data

requirements.statement: Athletes create reusable workout routines made up of a chosen list of exercises

criteria.must: An Athlete can create a routine with a name and an ordered list of exercises
A created routine appears in the Athlete's routines list

requirements.statement: Athletes edit or delete a routine

criteria.must: An Athlete can rename a routine or change its exercise list and the change is saved
An Athlete can delete a routine and it no longer appears in their routines list

requirements.statement: Athletes start a logged session from a routine or start a blank session and pick exercises ad hoc

criteria.must: An Athlete can start a session pre-populated with a chosen routine's exercises
An Athlete can start a blank session and add exercises ad hoc

requirements.statement: Athletes record each set's reps and weight for every exercise in a session

criteria.must: An Athlete can add a set with reps and weight to an exercise within an active session
Multiple sets can be logged for the same exercise within one session

requirements.statement: Athletes edit or delete a past session or set entry

criteria.must: An Athlete can edit a previously logged set's reps or weight
An Athlete can delete a previously logged set
An Athlete can delete an entire past session

requirements.statement: Athletes browse their workout history by date

criteria.must: An Athlete can view a list of past sessions ordered by date
Selecting a past session shows its logged exercises and sets

requirements.statement: Athletes view a strength trend for a specific exercise over time showing weight, reps, and estimated one-rep-max

criteria.must: An Athlete can select an exercise and see its weight/reps history plotted over time
Each trend point shows an estimated one-rep-max derived from that set's weight and reps

requirements.statement: Athletes see personal records (heaviest weight and best estimated one-rep-max) per exercise

criteria.must: The exercise progress view shows the heaviest weight ever logged for that exercise
The exercise progress view shows the best estimated one-rep-max ever achieved for that exercise

requirements.statement: Athletes set their preferred weight unit (kg or lb) and all weights display in that unit

criteria.must: An Athlete can choose kg or lb as their unit preference in settings
After changing the unit preference, logged weights are displayed converted to the chosen unit

requirements.statement: Athletes add custom exercises beyond any built-in list

criteria.must: An Athlete can add a new custom exercise with a name
A newly added custom exercise is selectable when building a routine or logging a session
